title: Conditional thermodynamic OS/KMS positivity passage contract
question: If finite Q3 transfer-word Gram entries and thermal two-word values converge on every fixed local word list along every declared exhaustion, which OS reflection-positivity and KMS identities pass to the limit, and which additional hypotheses are still required for a common QFT dynamics?
decision_reason: The exact logical passage is isolated: entrywise convergence of each finite word Gram matrix preserves every finite quadratic-form inequality, and finite thermal cyclicity passes to the limit when both complementary words converge under one beta and Euclidean-time convention. The contract is verified independently on two toy exhaustion scales and does not assert that the actual Q3 word limits or common carrier exist.
method: Generate the limiting three-word Gram matrix from rational vectors (1,0), (1,1), (0,1) and verify its quadratic form as a sum of two squares.
Use two explicit exhaustion sequences G+I/n and G+2I/n; check entrywise convergence, nonnegative quadratic forms and exact finite error decompositions for every declared coefficient vector.
Use a common beta*hbar=2 and symmetric Euclidean complement error s*(beta*hbar-s)/n to check finite KMS equality, boundedness and convergence on both cyclic sides.
Run an independently reconstructed Fraction-only lane, the integrated verifier and Lean R353; retain the actual Q3 common-word, exhaustion, dynamics and physical scope firewalls.
finding: Primary passes 187/187 assertions, independent passes 164/164, and the integrated verifier passes 35/35 with Lean R353 PASS. The exact limiting Gram quadratic values for the three coefficient fixtures are 2, 5 and 13; both toy exhaustion scales have the same limiting matrix and maximum sequence entry 4. The KMS fixture has limit 2, maximum finite word value 3, and exact equality for every declared time and denominator. Therefore positivity/KMS are stable under the stated word-wise convergence hypotheses, but the hypotheses are not established for the actual Q3 exhaustion.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional OS/KMS limit-passage contract only. It does not prove actual Q3 word convergence, a common OS carrier, action intertwining, product/core density, direct D or delta-D Cauchy, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, a GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or a Clay result.

adversarial_review.check: The limit argument is applied to each fixed finite coefficient vector and finite word list; no uncountable or operator-norm limit is silently inferred.
The contract is stated for complex sesquilinear Gram forms, while the exact fixture is real-rational and explicitly labelled a subcase.
The complement beta*hbar-s is represented explicitly and the two sides are separately computed; commutativity of A and B is not assumed.
The two toy scales demonstrate a common limit only for the fixture; actual Q3 exhaustion independence remains an unproved gate.
Quotient/completion is conditional on overlap compatibility and null-space identification, neither of which is claimed for actual Q3.
Limit positivity and KMS equality do not construct a common Hamiltonian-derived alpha_t, generator, group law or action intertwiner.
R353 checks exact rational sum-of-squares and KMS fixtures only; analytic convergence and Q3 operator limits remain hypotheses.
No GNS coercivity, broken-sector gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or Clay conclusion follows.

qft_interface.closed: Under explicit fixed-word convergence and overlap hypotheses, finite OS Gram positivity and finite thermal cyclicity pass to the limiting word functional.
